text:
sanjay gupta: Heads up — kicked off a SCIM bulk-replace after the KMS alias rotate and we’re seeing a spike in deprovisions + holes in audit logs. anyone around? :eyes:
irene chen: on it, oncall. what exactly are you seeing?
sanjay gupta: summary: ~2.4k deprov events in last 7m, a few users re-provisioned by a retry job, and the auth audit stream shows gaps for about 90s starting at 6512345662. service account tokens got invalidated too.
alex r.: logs? can you paste the worker output and KMS errors?
sanjay gupta: paste: ```
scim-worker[pid=4212] ERROR deprovisioner: failed to decrypt extId for user=svc-data-ingest code=KMS.Decrypt Error=InvalidCiphertextException alias=alias/redwood-prod-2026-rotate
scim-worker[pid=4212] INFO retry queued for user=U12345 job=bulk-replace
...
```
maria t.: that alias name is the new alias. did the keystore alias switch happen with a simultaneous role binding update? RBAC change was deployed in the same deploy window.
irene chen: yes, there was a tiny RBAC patch: we removed a legacy role that granted the scim-service principal access to kms:Decrypt on old aliases. opener: #PR-4982.
alex r.: so worker tries new alias but some objects still encrypted under old key material. if scim-service lost decrypt perms during rollout -> InvalidCiphertextException is expected.
sanjay gupta: correct. then workers fall back to queue-and-retry which re-encrypts or reprovisions and that triggers duplicate deprovs and re-provisions. logs show duplicate lifecycle events for same external_id.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423-scim-deprov-race 
scim-worker: note: batching tried 3x, KV-cache prefix hit rate dropped from 0.82 -> 0.13 during the spike.
maria t.: and audit pipeline: looks like auth-audit-ingestor had a memory pressure GC pause at 6512345665, it dropped an in-flight batch. that explains the 90s hole. trace id=trc-9a7b
irene chen: timeline: 6512345658 KMS alias rotate done, 6512345660 RBAC patch deployed, 6512345662 SCIM bulk-replace started, 6512345665 audit-ingestor GC pause, 6512345669 retries re-enqueued -> duplicate deprov churn.
alex r.: immediate mitigation: 1) revert RBAC change to restore kms:Decrypt for scim-service on old alias 2) pause scim bulk job 3) drain/clear retry queue 4) backfill missing audit events.
sanjay gupta: I paused the bulk job at 6512345670. current deprov rate down.
maria t.: i'm rolling RBAC revert now (will apply allow for scim-service on alias/* for the short window). doing it in staging-first then prod.
irene chen: for audit backfill — we can replay scim message queue to the audit pipeline, but need to mark replayed events with origin=backfill. We should also surface any user-facing changes (some users temporarily lost access).
ops-bot: deploy started: RBAC-revert v1 by maria t. (deploy-789)
maria t.: revert applied to prod at 6512345682. verified Decrypt succeeds against both aliases from scim service account.
sanjay gupta: test decrypt from scim pod: ```
$ kubectl exec -it scim-0 -- /bin/sh -c \"aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload --key-id alias/redwood-prod-2026-rotate\"
{ "Plaintext": "..." }
```
alex r.: good. next: drain retry queue and dedupe events before reprovisioning. sanjay can you run the dedupe script?
sanjay gupta: running dedupe now, will post logs.
scim-worker: dedupe run summary: 2400 entries scanned, 212 duplicates removed, 1888 requeued for safe reprovision.
irene chen: audit backfill: i'll re-ingest the scim-change topic for 6512345660-6512345690 with flag backfill=true. ops, please watch for double-create alerts in downstream systems.
ops-bot: backfill job queued: AUDIT-BACKFILL-44
maria t.: followups: 1) we need an automated pre-check that ensures service principals retain Decrypt perms for previous aliases until re-encryption completed. 2) add a short rolling window that pauses SCIM bulk jobs across RBAC-sensitive deploys. 3) increase audit-ingestor heap/GC headroom or add tombstone buffering to avoid batch drops.
alex r.: +1 on pre-check. maybe a small advisory in deploy pipeline: if KMS alias switching + RBAC role edits are in same PR, block and require a gated deploy with a canary that runs a quick decrypt test.
irene chen: filing follow-up issues: SEC-1228 (pre-check), INF-3345 (canary-decrypt), AUDIT-210 (ingestor GC/retention).
sanjay gupta: immediate owners: maria (RBAC), irene (audit backfill), alex (dedupe tooling). i'll keep monitoring. the incident channel is INC-2026-0423. thx all :heart:
ops-bot: INC-2026-0423 status -> mitigated (revert applied, backfill queued).
